description: R4 requires totals 'never NaN'. enrich sets net_worth_usd = usdc + eth*reader.ethUsdPrice() and marks src='chain' whenever no method THROWS — but a reader returning NaN (ethUsdPrice() -> NaN, or a NaN balance) does not throw, so a NaN net_worth is stamped 'chain' (verified). aggregate.sumVerified then does counted.reduce((s,r)=>s+(r[valueKey]||0)) — NaN is truthy so ||0 does NOT rescue it, and total_net_worth_usd becomes NaN, violating 'never NaN'. Same for revenue_mo_usd feeding earned_mo_usd. No Number.isFinite guard anywhere; no test with a NaN reader output.
fix: Treat non-finite reader output as unverified (Number.isFinite check) before stamping 'chain'; add a NaN-reader test asserting src='unverified' and total not NaN.
